name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3412: Both defects were named by the cross-family review of v3410, on code ONE HOUR OLD, and both reproduced before a line was changed. v3410 appended a FOUND or CREATED row for the derived hist root BEFORE the attempt ran, and the loop then appended a SECOND row when the write failed - reproduced with TV_FRAMES_DIR set and the hist dir at mode 0555, establish returned found AND unusable for the same root, so a reader taking the first hit archives into a directory whose write had just failed. The provenance now rides a FLAG and is spent in the ONE row the loop writes. And the agreement heart row left os.path.realpath outside its try, so an unresolvable path aborted the whole check instead of reporting UNKNOWN - a row that dies is not a row that answered. 13 cases, 6 red-proofs PROVEN. MY FIRST TRIGGER FOR THE SECOND ONE WAS WRONG AND THE CODE WAS FINE: I used a path with an embedded NUL believing realpath would raise, and measured it returning the string unchanged, so the test now makes realpath itself raise rather than hoping a proxy does.
